source.author: stat
source.text: tu dulces lituos ululataque proelia gaudes felix et miserae tantum moriture parenti.
source.text_original: tu dulces lituos ululataque proelia gaudes / felix et miserae tantum moriture parenti.
source.text_english: You delight in the sweet trumpets and the battles shouted over, fortunate one, and destined to die only for your wretched parent.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: te parvus lituos et bella loquentem miretur; sub te puerilia tela magistro senator ferat et nostram festinet ad hastam.
reuse.text_original: te parvus lituos et bella loquentem / miretur; sub te puerilia tela magistro / senator ferat et nostram festinet ad hastam.
reuse.text_english: Let the young man marvel at you, speaking of small trumpets and wars; under your guidance, let the senator as a boy bear weapons to school, and let him hasten to our spear.
